name: Fetch all livestreams
description: Fetch all livestreams Returns details of livestreams associated with the given App ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/livestreams
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/livestreams
Returns details of livestreams associated with the given App ID. It includes livestreams created by your App and RealtimeKit meetings that are livestreamed by your App. If you only want details of livestreams created by your App and not RealtimeKit meetings, you can use the `exclude_meetings` query parameter.
Required: account_id (path); app_id (path)
Optional: exclude_meetings (query) — Exclude the RealtimeKit meetings that are livestreamed.; per_page (query) — Number of results per page.; page_no (query) — The page number from which you want your page search results to be displayed.; status (query) — Specifies the status of the operation.; start_time (query) — Specify the start time range in ISO format to access the live stream.; end_time (query) — Specify the end time range in ISO format to access the live stream.; sort_order (query) — Specifies the sorting order for the results.

name: Fetch active recording

name: Fetch all meetings for an App
description: Fetch all meetings for an App Returns all meetings for the given App ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/meetings
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/meetings
Returns all meetings for the given App ID.
Required: account_id (path); app_id (path)
Optional: page_no (query) — The page number from which you want your page search results to be displayed.; per_page (query) — Number of results per page; start_time (query) — The start time range for which you want to retrieve the meetings. The time must be specified in ISO format.; end_time (query) — The end time range for which you want to retrieve the meetings. The time must be specified in ISO format.; search (query) — The search query string. You can search using the meeting ID or title.; status (query) — Filter meetings by status.

name: Fetch all recordings for an App
description: Fetch all recordings for an App Returns all recordings for an App. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/recordings
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/recordings
Returns all recordings for an App. If the `meeting_id` parameter is passed, returns all recordings for the given meeting ID.
Required: account_id (path); app_id (path)
Optional: meeting_id (query) — ID of a meeting. Optional. Will limit results to only this meeting if passed.; page_no (query) — The page number from which you want your page search results to be displayed.; per_page (query) — Number of results per page; expired (query) — If passed, only shows expired/non-expired recordings on RealtimeKit's bucket; search (query) — The search query string. You can search using the meeting ID or title.; sort_by (query); sort_order (query); start_time (query) — The start time range for which you want to retrieve the meetings. The time must be specified in ISO format.; end_time (query) — The end time range for which you want to retrieve the meetings. The time must be specified in ISO format.; status (query) — Filter by one or more recording status

description: Replace a webhook Replace all details for the given webhook ID. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/webhooks/{webhook_id}

name: Start recording a meeting
description: Start recording a meeting Starts recording a meeting. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/recordings
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/recordings
Starts recording a meeting. The meeting can be started by an App admin directly, or a participant with permissions to start a recording, based on the type of authorization used.
Required: account_id (path); app_id (path); body (body)

name: Start livestreaming a meeting
description: Start livestreaming a meeting Starts livestream of a meeting associated with the given meeting ID. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/meetings/{meeting_id}/livestreams
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/meetings/{meeting_id}/livestreams
Starts livestream of a meeting associated with the given meeting ID. Retreive the meeting ID using the `Create a meeting` API.
Required: account_id (path); app_id (path); meeting_id (path) — ID of the meeting; body (body)

name: Start recording participant audio tracks
description: Start recording participant audio tracks Starts track recording for a meeting. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/recordings/track
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/recordings/track
Starts track recording for a meeting. Track recording currently records separate participant audio tracks as WebM files in the RealtimeKit bucket. Video track recording is in development. For more information, refer to [Track recording](/realtime/realtimekit/recording-guide/track-recording/).
Required: account_id (path); app_id (path); body (body) — Starts audio track recording for an active meeting. Use `layers` only when you need to set a file name prefix. Selective track recording (`user_ids`) is in early beta contact support to use this feature.

name: Stop livestreaming a meeting
description: Stop livestreaming a meeting Stops the active livestream of a meeting associated with the given meeting ID. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/meetings/{meeting_id}/active-livestream/stop
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/meetings/{meeting_id}/active-livestream/stop
Stops the active livestream of a meeting associated with the given meeting ID. Retreive the meeting ID using the `Create a meeting` API.
Required: account_id (path); app_id (path); meeting_id (path) — ID of the meeting

name: Update a meeting
description: Update a meeting Updates a meeting in an App for the given meeting ID. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/realtime/kit/{app_id}/meetings/{meeting_id}
